title: The Defrocked Priest
text: A priest stripped of his robes begs at the Court's gate, the shaved patch on his head grown out ragged. He still blesses the people who kick him. He knows how the Court is run, he whispers, every bribe and every body, for a price.

options.label: Pay him for the Court's secrets.

outcomes.text: A back way through the Court, past every guard.
He takes the money, and runs, and laughs.

options.label: The kindest gives him bread instead.

outcomes.text: He weeps, and eats, and tells you everything, every bribe and every body.

options.label: Turn him over to the Court.

outcomes.text: The Court thanks you, and lets you pass. You hear him blessing them as they drag him off.
